description: EigenLayer is a restaking protocol on Ethereum where users deposit liquid staking tokens (stETH, ETHx, mETH, and others) into strategy contracts, or point native validator withdrawal credentials at EigenPods, to extend those assets' cryptoeconomic security to Actively Validated Services (AVSs). The core contracts are upgradeable behind transparent proxies and governed by two timelocks: a 10-day timelock for Protocol Council upgrades, and a 24-day timelock that applies to EIGEN and bEIGEN token upgrades. A 1-of-7 Pauser Multisig can freeze all strategy contracts, locking {{totalCapitalAtRisk}} in restaked LSTs without on-chain time delay, while the Unpauser (1-of-2 Owning Multisig) can restore operations. Each supported LST token contract is a direct dependency: a malfunction or compromise of those contracts would affect the strategy holding that token.

eth:0x5050389572f2d220ad927CcbeA0D406831.name: EigenLayer Pauser Multisig (1-of-7)
eth:0x5050389572f2d220ad927CcbeA0D406831.description: Can call pause() and pauseAll() on all 13 strategy contracts (12 StrategyBaseTVLLimits + EigenStrategy), DelegationManager, StrategyManager, AllocationManager, RewardsCoordinator, AVSDirectory, and related contracts. When paused, user deposit and withdrawal operations on those contracts are blocked until the EigenLayerOwningMultisig (unpauser) restores them. Direct capital subject to pause: {{pauserMultisigCapital}}.

eth:0xBE1685C81aA44FF9FB319dD389addd9374.name: EigenLayer Operations Multisig (3-of-6)
eth:0xBE1685C81aA44FF9FB319dD389addd9374.description: PROPOSER and CANCELLER on both TimelockControllers (the 10-day primary and 24-day bEIGEN). Direct owner of RewardsCoordinator, DelegationManager, EigenPodManager, AllocationManager, EmissionsController, and several EigenDA contracts. Can set rewards updater, fee recipient, activation delay, proof timestamp setter, and proposeProofTimestampSetter on EigenPodManager — affecting beacon-chain withdrawal validation for all native-ETH restakers ({{nativeEthRestaking}}). Auto-detected reach of {{operationsMultisigCapital}} covers the 12 LST strategies; the native-ETH exposure routes through the same proxy-upgrade authority (via ProxyAdmin owner).

eth:0x369e6F597e22EaB55fFb173C6d9cD234BD.name: EigenLayer Owning Multisig (1-of-2)
eth:0x369e6F597e22EaB55fFb173C6d9cD234BD.description: Sole unpauser for all EigenLayer contracts. Owner of the main EigenLayer ProxyAdmin (0x8b9566) which controls upgrades to all 31 core protocol proxies (DelegationManager, StrategyManager, AllocationManager, EigenPodManager, EmissionsController, RewardsCoordinator, 12 StrategyBaseTVLLimits LST pools). Also owner of the EigenPodBeacon (UpgradeableBeacon at 0x5a2a4F...) — a malicious EigenPod implementation upgrade can fake or block beacon-chain withdrawal proofs across ALL native-ETH restakers, affecting the entire {{nativeEthRestaking}} restaked natively (the engine's auto-detected reach of {{owningMultisigCapital}} only covers the 12 LST strategies; native-ETH is tracked via aggregate handler and not auto-attributed). The 1-of-2 threshold makes this effectively a single-key control.

eth:0x27a84740FdDed5B7D66d9bb6E5d1DEA6eb.name: ProtocolRegistry (Pauser)
eth:0x27a84740FdDed5B7D66d9bb6E5d1DEA6eb.description: An on-chain registry contract that is also registered as a pauser in the EigenLayer PauserRegistry. Its pauseAll() function can pause all registered EigenLayer contracts. The PAUSER_ROLE holders on ProtocolRegistry control this capability; role membership was not resolvable via on-chain query and requires manual verification. Direct capital reachable: {{protocolRegistryCapital}}.

eth:0x5e4C39Ad7A3E881585e383dB9827EB4811.name: StrategyFactory
eth:0x5e4C39Ad7A3E881585e383dB9827EB4811.description: Internal protocol contract that deploys and manages StrategyBaseTVLLimits proxies. The Operations Multisig owns it. Can whitelist or blacklist tokens from new strategy deployments and add/remove strategies from the deposit whitelist in StrategyManager. No direct fund exposure since it only affects deployment of new strategies, not existing ones.

eth:0x8f94F55fD8c9E090296283137C303fE97d.name: RewardsCoordinator Updater (EOA)
eth:0x8f94F55fD8c9E090296283137C303fE97d.description: Externally owned account set as rewardsUpdater on the RewardsCoordinator. Can submit distribution roots (submitRoot) and disable pending roots (disableRoot) for the EIGEN rewards distribution system. Root submissions activate after a 7-day delay during which they can be overridden. No direct fund exposure to restaked LSTs.

eth:0x218B5eC7482e072F6D47feb0463B3297eF.name: EIGEN Incentive Council (3-of-5 Multisig)
eth:0x218B5eC7482e072F6D47feb0463B3297eF.description: The incentiveCouncil of the EmissionsController, responsible for adding and updating EIGEN emission distributions across AVSs and strategies. Controls how weekly EIGEN token emissions are allocated. Can also call sweep() on the EmissionsController to recover non-EIGEN tokens sent to the contract.

eth:0x130d8EA0052B45554e4C99079B84df2921.name: EigenDA EjectionManager
eth:0x130d8EA0052B45554e4C99079B84df2921.description: Internal EigenDA contract that can eject operators from quorums via the RegistryCoordinator's ejectOperator() function. Controlled by the EigenDA Operations Multisig. Ejection affects operator participation in EigenDA quorums but does not touch restaking balances or user withdrawal rights.

eth:0x002721B4790d97dC140a049936aA710152.name: EigenDA Operations Multisig (3-of-4)
eth:0x002721B4790d97dC140a049936aA710152.description: Owner of EigenDAServiceManager, RegistryCoordinator, and related EigenDA contracts. Can set quorum operator set parameters, churn approver, ejector, staleStakesForbidden flag, batch confirmers, and rewards initiator. Also owns the EigenDA ProxyAdmin (0x8247EF) controlling upgrades to EigenDA contracts. No direct exposure to restaked LST balances.

eth:0x0BAAc79acD45A023E19345c352d8a7a83C.name: EigenDA RegistryCoordinator
eth:0x0BAAc79acD45A023E19345c352d8a7a83C.description: Internal EigenDA contract that manages operator registration and deregistration in BLSApkRegistry, IndexRegistry, StakeRegistry, and SocketRegistry. Called by EigenDA operators to join/leave quorums. Not a human-controlled admin — it is gated by on-chain quorum rules and ejection logic.

eth:0x8ED83c6Bb12E441Ca2C3a544F525d4a3Fb.name: EigenDA Batch Confirmer (EOA)
eth:0x8ED83c6Bb12E441Ca2C3a544F525d4a3Fb.description: One of several EOAs listed as batchConfirmers in EigenDAServiceManager. Can call confirmBatch() to confirm EigenDA data availability. This is an operational DA role with no direct impact on restaking balances or LST withdrawals.

eth:0x5A49Bf6c5690E22dFff3eB37F7dd18254e.name: EigenDA Batch Confirmer (EOA)
eth:0x5A49Bf6c5690E22dFff3eB37F7dd18254e.description: One of several EOAs listed as batchConfirmers in EigenDAServiceManager. Can call confirmBatch() to confirm EigenDA data availability. This is an operational DA role with no direct impact on restaking balances or LST withdrawals.

eth:0x454Ef2f69f91527856E06659f92a66f464.name: EigenDA Batch Confirmer (EOA)
eth:0x454Ef2f69f91527856E06659f92a66f464.description: One of several EOAs listed as batchConfirmers in EigenDAServiceManager. Can call confirmBatch() to confirm EigenDA data availability. This is an operational DA role with no direct impact on restaking balances or LST withdrawals.

eth:0x178eeeA9E0928dA2153A1d7951FBe30CF8.name: EigenLayer Rewards Initiator Multisig (3-of-4)
eth:0x178eeeA9E0928dA2153A1d7951FBe30CF8.description: Set as rewardsInitiator on EigenDAServiceManager. Can create AVS rewards submissions and operator-directed reward submissions for EigenDA operators. Manages EigenDA operator reward flows; no direct effect on restaking deposits or LST balances.

eth:0x942eaF324971440384e4cA0ffA39fC3bb3.name: EigenLayer EIGEN Token Owning Multisig (1-of-2)
eth:0x942eaF324971440384e4cA0ffA39fC3bb3.description: Owns the ProxyAdmin (0x3f5Ab2) for the BackingEigen (bEIGEN) token proxy. Can upgrade the bEIGEN token implementation, which backs EIGEN 1:1. Also controls who can mint bEIGEN via setIsMinter() and manages transfer restrictions on the token. The 1-of-2 threshold provides minimal governance friction over the EIGEN token supply mechanics.

eth:0x461854d84Ee845F905e0eCf6C288DDEEb4.name: EigenLayer Operations Multisig 2 (3-of-5)
eth:0x461854d84Ee845F905e0eCf6C288DDEEb4.description: Executor on both TimelockControllers (10-day and 24-day) and proposer on the 24-day timelock. Can execute queued proposals after their delay expires and schedule new proposals on the 24-day timelock. Works in tandem with the Operations Multisig to manage protocol upgrade execution.

eth:0xD2Ee81Cf07B12140C793FcE5B26313CDd9.name: EigenDA Ejector (EOA)
eth:0xD2Ee81Cf07B12140C793FcE5B26313CDd9.description: One of several addresses authorized as ejectors in EigenDA's EjectionManager. Can call ejectOperators() to forcibly remove EigenDA operators that violate ejection thresholds. Operational EigenDA role with no impact on restaking strategy balances.

eth:0x8642473a123FE33b0aaE90bD8604eA1029.name: EigenDA Ejector (EOA)
eth:0x8642473a123FE33b0aaE90bD8604eA1029.description: One of several addresses authorized as ejectors in EigenDA's EjectionManager. Can call ejectOperators() to forcibly remove EigenDA operators that violate ejection thresholds. Operational EigenDA role with no impact on restaking strategy balances.

eth:0x338477FfaF63c04AC06048787f910671eC.name: EigenDA Multisig (3-of-8)
eth:0x338477FfaF63c04AC06048787f910671eC.description: One of several addresses with ejection authority in EigenDA's EjectionManager. Can remove EigenDA operators via ejectOperators(). Also holds pauser permissions on the EigenDA PauserRegistry chain. Operational EigenDA role with no exposure to restaking LST balances.

eth:0x0000000000000000000000000000000000.name: Zero Address (Renounced)
eth:0x0000000000000000000000000000000000.description: The EigenPod beacon implementation stores zero addresses for podOwner and proofSubmitter at the implementation contract level. Deployed EigenPods are owned by individual users; the zero address here reflects the uninitialized state of the shared implementation, not a live admin slot.

eth:0x5557E1fE3068A1e823cE5Dcd052c6C352E.name: OperatorTableUpdater
eth:0x5557E1fE3068A1e823cE5Dcd052c6C352E.description: Internal protocol contract that manages cross-chain operator table updates used by BN254CertificateVerifier and ECDSACertificateVerifier. Only the EigenLayer Operations Multisig (as owner) and a configured generator address can update the global operator table root. No exposure to restaking LST balances.

eth:0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312.name: stETH (Lido)
eth:0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312.description: The stETH strategy (StrategyBaseTVLLimits) holds users' Lido Staked Ether deposits, representing {{stethStrategyBalance}} of restaked LSTs. EigenLayer calls balanceOf() and transfer() on this token contract for deposits and withdrawals. A stETH token upgrade or freeze would directly affect users with stETH restaked on EigenLayer.

eth:0xA35b1B31Ce002FBF2058D22F30f95D4052.name: ETHx (Stader)
eth:0xA35b1B31Ce002FBF2058D22F30f95D4052.description: The ETHx strategy holds Stader's liquid staking token representing {{ethxStrategyBalance}} in restaked assets. EigenLayer calls balanceOf() and transfer() on ETHx for strategy accounting. A token-level issue or governance action on Stader's ETHx contract would affect restakers in this strategy.

eth:0xd5F7838F5C461fefF7FE49ea5ebaF7728b.name: mETH (Mantle)
eth:0xd5F7838F5C461fefF7FE49ea5ebaF7728b.description: Mantle's Staked ETH token held in the mETH strategy, representing {{mETHStrategyBalance}} in restaked assets. EigenLayer strategies interact with mETH via the standard ERC-20 interface for balance checks and transfers.

eth:0x8c1BEd5b9a0928467c9B1341Da1D7BD5e1.name: LsETH (Liquid Collective)
eth:0x8c1BEd5b9a0928467c9B1341Da1D7BD5e1.description: Liquid Collective's LsETH token held in its dedicated strategy, representing {{lsETHStrategyBalance}}. Interaction is via ERC-20 balanceOf() and transfer(). Liquid Collective's access control system (Firewalls, AllowlistV1) controls who can transfer LsETH.

eth:0xf951E335afb289353dc249e82926178EaC.name: swETH (Swell)
eth:0xf951E335afb289353dc249e82926178EaC.description: Swell's Liquid Staked Ether token held in its dedicated strategy, representing {{swETHStrategyBalance}}. Swell's AccessControlManager governs swETH administration. EigenLayer interacts via standard ERC-20 interface for deposits and withdrawals.

eth:0xf1C9acDc66974dFB6dEcB12aA385b9cD01.name: osETH (Stakewise)
eth:0xf1C9acDc66974dFB6dEcB12aA385b9cD01.description: Stakewise's OsToken held in the osETH strategy, representing {{osETHStrategyBalance}}. EigenLayer calls balanceOf() and transfer() for strategy accounting.

eth:0xac3E018457B222d93114458476f3E3416A.name: sfrxETH (Frax Finance)
eth:0xac3E018457B222d93114458476f3E3416A.description: Frax Finance's Staked Frax Ether held in the sfrxETH strategy, representing {{sfrxETHStrategyBalance}}. Frax's timelock and owner govern sfrxETH upgrades. EigenLayer interacts via ERC-20 interface.

eth:0xBe9895146f7AF43049ca1c1AE358B0541E.name: cbETH (Coinbase)
eth:0xBe9895146f7AF43049ca1c1AE358B0541E.description: Coinbase's Wrapped Staked ETH held in the cbETH strategy, representing {{cbETHStrategyBalance}}. cbETH uses Circle's FiatToken proxy pattern with blacklister and master minter roles. EigenLayer interacts via ERC-20 interface.

eth:0x856c4Efb76C1D1AE02e20CEB03A2A6a08b.name: OETH (Origin Protocol)
eth:0x856c4Efb76C1D1AE02e20CEB03A2A6a08b.description: Origin Ether held in the OETH strategy, representing {{oETHStrategyBalance}}. Origin Protocol's governor and vault control OETH administration. EigenLayer interacts via ERC-20 interface.

eth:0xae78736Cd615f374D3085123A210448E74.name: rETH (Rocket Pool)
eth:0xae78736Cd615f374D3085123A210448E74.description: Rocket Pool's ETH token held in the rETH strategy, representing {{rETHStrategyBalance}}. EigenLayer interacts via ERC-20 interface for deposits and withdrawals from this strategy.

eth:0xE95A203B1a91a908F9B9CE46459d101078.name: ankrETH (Ankr)
eth:0xE95A203B1a91a908F9B9CE46459d101078.description: Ankr's Staked ETH token held in the ankrETH strategy, representing {{ankrETHStrategyBalance}}. EigenLayer interacts via ERC-20 interface.

eth:0xa2E3356610840701BDf5611a53974510Ae.name: wBETH (Binance)
eth:0xa2E3356610840701BDf5611a53974510Ae.description: Binance's Wrapped Beacon ETH (wBETH) held in its dedicated strategy, representing {{wBETHStrategyBalance}}. EigenLayer interacts via balanceOf() reads only; a centrally controlled token issued by Binance staking infrastructure.

eth:0x93c4b944D05dfe6df7645A86cd2206016c.name: stETH Strategy
eth:0x93c4b944D05dfe6df7645A86cd2206016c.description: Holds {{stethStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked stETH. This is the largest single strategy by TVS. Users restake their Lido Staked Ether here to earn EigenLayer points and participate in AVS security. Can be paused by the 1-of-7 EigenLayerPauserMultisig, blocking deposits and withdrawals.

eth:0x9d7eD45EE2E8FC5482fa2428f15C971e63.name: ETHx Strategy
eth:0x9d7eD45EE2E8FC5482fa2428f15C971e63.description: Holds {{ethxStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked ETHx (Stader). Second-largest strategy by TVS. Standard StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to the same pause and upgrade controls as all other strategies.

eth:0xaCB55C530Acdb2849e6d4f36992Cd8c9D5.name: EIGEN Strategy
eth:0xaCB55C530Acdb2849e6d4f36992Cd8c9D5.description: Holds {{eigenStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked bEIGEN tokens (backing the EIGEN governance token). Users who restake EIGEN here participate in EigenLayer's native token security model. Pause and upgrade controls apply as with LST strategies.

eth:0x298aFB19A105D59E74658C4C334Ff360Ba.name: mETH Strategy
eth:0x298aFB19A105D59E74658C4C334Ff360Ba.description: Holds {{mETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked mETH (Mantle Staked ETH). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0xAe60d8180437b5C34bB956822ac2710972.name: LsETH Strategy
eth:0xAe60d8180437b5C34bB956822ac2710972.description: Holds {{lsETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked LsETH (Liquid Collective). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x0Fe4F44beE93503346A3Ac9EE5A26b130a.name: swETH Strategy
eth:0x0Fe4F44beE93503346A3Ac9EE5A26b130a.description: Holds {{swETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked swETH (Swell). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x57ba429517c3473B6d34CA9aCd56c0e735.name: osETH Strategy
eth:0x57ba429517c3473B6d34CA9aCd56c0e735.description: Holds {{osETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked osETH (Stakewise OsToken). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x8CA7A5d6f3acd3A7A8bC468a8CD0FB14B6.name: sfrxETH Strategy
eth:0x8CA7A5d6f3acd3A7A8bC468a8CD0FB14B6.description: Holds {{sfrxETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked sfrxETH (Frax Finance). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x54945180dB7943c0ed0FEE7EdaB2Bd2462.name: cbETH Strategy
eth:0x54945180dB7943c0ed0FEE7EdaB2Bd2462.description: Holds {{cbETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked cbETH (Coinbase Wrapped Staked ETH). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0xa4C637e0F704745D182e4D38cAb7E74853.name: OETH Strategy
eth:0xa4C637e0F704745D182e4D38cAb7E74853.description: Holds {{oETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked OETH (Origin Protocol). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x1BeE69b7dFFfA4E2d53C2a2Df135C388AD.name: rETH Strategy
eth:0x1BeE69b7dFFfA4E2d53C2a2Df135C388AD.description: Holds {{rETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked rETH (Rocket Pool). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x13760F50a9d7377e4F20CB8CF9e4c26586.name: ankrETH Strategy
eth:0x13760F50a9d7377e4F20CB8CF9e4c26586.description: Holds {{ankrETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked ankrETH (Ankr). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x7CA911E83dabf90C90dD3De5411a10F1A6.name: wBETH Strategy
eth:0x7CA911E83dabf90C90dD3De5411a10F1A6.description: Holds {{wBETHStrategyBalance}} of user-restaked wBETH (Wrapped Binance ETH). StrategyBaseTVLLimits contract subject to standard EigenLayer governance controls.

eth:0x91E677b07F7AF907ec9a428aafA9fc14a0.name: EigenPodManager (Native ETH Restaking)
eth:0x91E677b07F7AF907ec9a428aafA9fc14a0.description: Tracks {{nativeEthRestaking}} in ETH restaked natively by Ethereum validators whose withdrawal credentials point to EigenPod contracts. This value comes from DeFiLlama's EigenLayer adapter and represents ETH locked in the Ethereum beacon chain — not a token balance that can be read on-chain directly. EigenPods receive ETH only when validators make partial or full withdrawals.

eth:0xec53bF9167f50cDEB3Ae105f56099aaaB9.name: EIGEN Token
eth:0xec53bF9167f50cDEB3Ae105f56099aaaB9.description: The EIGEN governance and intersubjective work token with market capitalization of {{eigenTokenMarketCap}}. Transfer restrictions can be modified by the EigenLayerOwningMultisig; the token implementation is upgradeable via the main EigenLayer ProxyAdmin.

eth:0x83E9115d334D248Ce39a6f36144aEaB5b3.name: bEIGEN Token (BackingEigen)
eth:0x83E9115d334D248Ce39a6f36144aEaB5b3.description: The backing token for EIGEN with market capitalization of {{bEigenTokenMarketCap}}. Held in the EIGEN Strategy contract as collateral. The bEIGEN token has a minting role system controlled by the EigenLayer EIGEN Token Owning Multisig (1-of-2).
